findings.title: Missing React key on Grafana list item
findings.body: In FilterViewResults the grafana branch now renders <GrafanaRuleListItem> without key={key} while the datasource and unknown branches still pass key. Without a stable key React will warn and can reuse the wrong component instance when rules are appended during infinite scroll, causing incorrect state, actions, or expanded content per row.

findings.title: Silence drawer never opens for prom-only rules
findings.body: AlertRuleMenu now derives canSilence from promRule so Silence notifications can appear in the ruler-less list view, but the drawer is still gated on rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) with the ruler DTO. When only promRule is present, handleSilence sets showSilenceDrawer to true yet the SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer which requires rulerRule is never rendered, so clicking Silence appears to do nothing.

findings.title: Federated-rule immutability check removed
findings.body: useAllRulerRuleAbilities hardcodes isFederated to false with a TODO, and useAllAlertRuleAbilities was refactored to delegate without passing the CombinedRule group. Previously federated groups detected via isFederatedRuleGroup made rules immutable for Update/Delete/Pause/Restore. Now federated Mimir/Cortex rules are treated as mutable, so UI can offer edit, delete, pause and duplicate on rules that should be blocked.
